server.settings.title: Settings
server.tooltip_mod_log_channel: Main log channel where all actions (bot config updates, user bans, mod actions) are sent unless specific channels are selected.
server.tooltip_moderation: Toggle the global auto moderation system on this server.
server.tooltip_moderation_whitelist_chan: Choose the channels where moderation is allowed.
server.tooltip_moderation_blacklist_chan: Choose the channels where moderation is not allowed.
server.tooltip_moderation_type: Choose between regular filter criteria or powerful automated AI text analyzing.
server.tooltip_rules: Define operational boundaries and evaluation parameters used exclusively when AI filtering mode is active.
server.tooltip_aibot: Allows the bot to chat using server context upon mentions and execute admin commands triggered by active staff.
server.tooltip_aibot_whitelist_channels: Choose the channels where the AI bot is allowed.
server.tooltip_aibot_blacklist_channels: Choose the channels where the AI bot is not allowed.
server.tooltip_ai_message_ttl: Time in seconds before the bot auto-deletes its standard responses. Set to 0 or leave empty to keep messages forever.
server.tooltip_ai_long_message_ttl: Cleanup timeout specifically for large responses exceeding 1 block (2,000+ characters). Set to 0 to preserve indefinitely.
server.tooltip_word_channel: Select the text channel where users play word chains. Game remains offline if unselected.
server.tooltip_words: List of sequentially logged words to prevent immediate repetitions during active matches.
server.tooltip_filter: Normal validates character matching. Extreme enforces validation against structured dictionaries (highly optimized for English).
server.tooltip_number_channel: Select the active text channel where members count incrementally (+1 per message).
server.tooltip_news: Receive generalized notifications and system-wide news alerts.
server.tooltip_news_channel: Channel where standard news are directed. Bot will dynamically look for a placeholder if unassigned.
server.tooltip_important: Receive crucial information regarding configuration modifications, user dataset updates, and major updates.
server.tooltip_important_channel: Channel for high-priority broadcasts. Bot falls back to system defaults if left empty.
server.tooltip_critical: Emergency system announcements regarding unexpected downtime, maintenance, or core database restorations. This channel cannot be disabled.
server.tooltip_critical_channel: Destination for critical alerts. The bot automatically resolves channel detection if unassigned.
server.tooltip_ttl_channel: Auto-delete the last message in a channel after a set time. Format: 1d 2h 30m 10s
server.tooltip_ai_message_delete: Automatically delete both the user's message and the AI's reply after a set time.
server.ttl_zero: Duration must be greater than zero
server.tooltip_save_messages: Enable message saving to generate message charts for this server.
server.tooltip_save_voice: Enable voice time tracking to generate voice charts for this server.
server.tooltip_save_activity: Enable Discord activity tracking to generate activity charts for this server.

home.hero.title: Server activity — finally readable.
home.hero.subtitle: Profiles, graphs, leaderboards, economy and privacy — in one bot. No corporate tone. Just useful stuff.
home.hero.b1: Charts for messages + voice, any period
home.features.title: What Wolium can do
home.features.subtitle: I’m not trying to look “huge”. I’m trying to look useful. Here’s the stuff you’ll actually feel in daily usage.
home.feature.profile.title: User profiles that actually tell something
home.feature.profile.text: Avatar, status, level, XP, money, messages, voice time — plus server details if available.
home.feature.profile.b1: View your profile or someone else’s
home.feature.charts.title: Charts with message preview
home.feature.charts.text: Pick any time range. Tooltip shows a message preview, click opens it in Discord.
home.feature.leaderboard.title: Leaderboards for literally everything
home.feature.leaderboard.text: Total money, bank, cash, XP, level, messages, voice time, votes, vote streak — global or server.
home.feature.tools.title: Tools (not only “fun commands”)
home.feature.tools.text: Message translation, link redirect tree, number formatting, holidays, reports, message auto-delete (TTL).
home.feature.privacy.title: Privacy controls baked in
home.feature.privacy.text: You control what is stored. /delete_data removes saved messages and voice activity permanently.
home.feature.ai.title: AI tools
home.feature.ai.text: AI moderation/automation exists, but it’s still evolving. I’m improving it step by step — without overpromising.
home.feature.ai.b2: Future: natural-language control for bot actions
home.why.title: Why this bot
home.why.subtitle: A bot can have 200 commands and still be useless. Wolium is built around “daily value”.
home.why.i1.title: Dashboard, not a spreadsheet
home.why.i1.text: UI is part of the product: charts, profiles, tooltips, quick navigation.
home.why.i2.title: Updates without pain
home.why.i2.text: New features show up fast (often without a bot restart).
home.why.i3.title: Community-first
home.why.i3.text: Ideas from users aren’t “noted”, they actually get implemented.
home.why.i4.title: Localization
home.why.i4.text: Bot supports 25 languages. Site supports RU/EN/ES/UA (you can contribute!).
home.why.i5.title: Privacy by design
home.why.i5.text: You decide what data is stored. You can delete it.
home.why.i6.title: Made by one dev since 2023
home.why.i6.text: No “corporate bot”. Just a long-running project that keeps improving.
home.cta.title: Ready to try it on your server?
home.cta.text: Add Wolium, play with profiles and charts, and tell me what to improve next.
